summary: A first-person 3D physics puzzle game built in Roblox Studio inspired by NASA's abandoned spacecraft (Voyager 1, Opportunity, Apollo 11, InSight, and Sojourner), where players rewind their spatial coordinates and conserve kinetic inertia to reach the core of a forgotten station.
